pairs: In the beginning was the Word,
and the Word was with God,
Hoc erat in principio apud Deum.
He was with God in the beginning.
All things were made through Him,
et sine ipso factum est nihil, quod factum est.
and nothing that was made was made without Him.
and Life was the light of men.
And the light shines in the darkness,
and the darkness did not comprehend it.
There was a man sent by God,
Hic venit in testimonium ut testimonium perhiberet de lumine,
He arrived as a witness to offer testimony about the Light,
so that all would believe through him.
sed ut testimonium perhiberet de lumine.
but he was to offer testimony about the Light.
quæ illuminat omnem hominem venientem in hunc mundum.
which illuminates every man, was coming into this world.
et mundus per ipsum factus est,
and the world was made through him,
and the world did not recognize him.
and his own did not accept him.
dedit eis potestatem filios Dei fieri,
those who believed in his name,
his qui credunt in nomine ejus:
he gave them the power to become the sons of God.
These are born, not of blood,
nor of the will of flesh,
neque ex voluntate viri, sed ex Deo nati sunt.
nor of the will of man, but of God.
gloriam quasi unigeniti a Patre plenum gratiæ
glory like that of an only-begotten Son from the Father,
John offers testimony about him, and he cries out,
et clamat dicens: Hic erat quem dixi:
saying: “This is the one about whom I said:
‘He who is to come after me,
has been placed ahead of me,
Et de plenitudine ejus nos omnes accepimus,
And from his fullness, we all have received,
quia lex per Moysen data est,
For the law was given through Moses,
gratia et veritas per Jesum Christum facta est.
but grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
who is in the bosom of the Father,
And this is the testimony of John,
quando miserunt Judæi ab Jerosolymis sacerdotes
when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to him,
et Levitas ad eum ut interrogarent eum:
so that they might ask him,
Quis es ut responsum demus his qui miserunt nos?
“Who are you, so that we may give an answer to those who sent us?
What do you say about yourself?”
“I am a voice crying out in the desert,
‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’
just as the prophet Isaiah said.”
Et qui missi fuerant, erant ex pharisæis.
And some of those who had been sent were from among the Pharisees.
if you are not the Christ,
But in your midst stands one,
Ipse est qui post me venturus est,
The same is he who is to come after me,
who has been placed ahead of me,
cujus ego non sum dignus ut solvam ejus corrigiam calceamenti.
the laces of whose shoes I am not worthy to loosen.”
Hæc in Bethania facta sunt trans Jordanem,
These things happened in Bethania, across the Jordan,
Altera die vidit Joannes Jesum venientem ad se,
On the next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him, and so he said:
he who takes away the sin of the world.
This is the one about whom I said,
Post me venit vir qui ante me factus est:
‘After me arrives a man, who has been placed ahead of me,
And I did not know him.
Yet it is for this reason that I come baptizing with water:
propterea veni ego in aqua baptizans.
so that he may be made manifest in Israel.”
Quia vidi Spiritum descendentem quasi columbam de cælo,
“For I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove;
And I did not know him.
sed qui misit me baptizare in aqua, ille mihi dixit:
But he who sent me to baptize with water said to me:
Super quem videris Spiritum descendentem, et manentem super eum,
‘He over whom you will see the Spirit descending and remaining upon him,
hic est qui baptizat in Spiritu Sancto.
this is the one who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.’
et testimonium perhibui quia hic est Filius Dei.
and I gave testimony: that this one is the Son of God.”
John was standing with two of his disciples.
And catching sight of Jesus walking, he said,
Et audierunt eum duo discipuli loquentem,
And two disciples were listening to him speaking.
Conversus autem Jesus, et videns eos sequentes se,
Then Jesus, turning around and seeing them following him,
He said to them, “Come and see.”
They went and saw where he was staying,
et apud eum manserunt die illo:
and they stayed with him that day.
Now it was about the tenth hour.
unus ex duobus qui audierant a Joanne,
was one of the two who had heard about him from John
Invenit hic primum fratrem suum Simonem,
First, he found his brother Simon, and he said to him,
et dicit ei: Invenimus Messiam (quod est interpretatum Christus).
“We have found the Messiah,” (which is translated as the Christ).
And he led him to Jesus.
In crastinum voluit exire in Galilæam,
On the next day, he wanted to go into Galilee,
the city of Andrew and Peter.
Philip found Nathanael, and he said to him,
et dicit ei: Quem scripsit Moyses in lege, et prophetæ,
“We have found the one about whom Moses wrote in the Law and the Prophets:
invenimus Jesum filium Joseph a Nazareth.
Jesus, the son of Joseph, from Nazareth.”
A Nazareth potest aliquid boni esse?
Vidit Jesus Nathanaël venientem ad se,
Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him,
an Israelite in whom truly there is no deceit.”
when you were under the fig tree,
you are the Son of God.
You are the King of Israel.”
“Because I told you that I saw you under the fig tree,
and the Angels of God ascending and descending over the Son of man.”
